name: competitor-signal-monitor
description: Monitor named competitors for meaningful changes across dated sources and deliver a cited change digest. Use for ongoing competitor surveillance; use competitor-profile for one-time dossiers, competitive-intelligence for cross-company comparisons, and change-and-price-watch for a single-source alert. Not for one-time competitor dossiers (competitor-profile) or a single-source alert (change-and-price-watch).
triggers: monitor competitor pricing changes over time
monitor competitor launches and pricing changes
